title: Good credit starts with great habits
summary: Good credit can take you places. From everyday purchases to life's biggest milestones, discover smart habits that can make a difference.
body_markdown:
## **** Why good credit matters


Good credit means more financial opportunities. Whether you're buying a home, financing a car or planning for the unexpected, a strong credit history can make it easier to qualify for loans and secure better rates.


## **** Small habits. Big possibilities.


Want to learn more? Explore Great Southern Bank's free financial education resources, including courses on credit scores, managing debt and building healthy financial habits.


[Start Learning](https://www.greatsouthernbank.com/about/financial-education)
